description:
Verify Photoshop is installed and reachable on this machine.

Use when: once at session start if connection status is unknown.
Do NOT use when: on every tool call — call once, then use photoshop_get_state.

Returns: connection success or failure message. May append a FEEDBACK_NUDGE block 15 minutes after the first successful ping, then at most once per 7 days (disabled with PSMCP_FEEDBACK=0).
Preconditions: none. Side effects: may trigger Photoshop detection.
name: photoshop_ping
